### Linux 桌面图标与通知 / Linux desktop icon and notifications

- **修复 Ubuntu Dock 和通知来源名称乱码（#92）**。GNOME 现在能将 XWayland 和原生 Wayland 窗口关联到茶话间，显示中文名称和茶杯图标。
- deb 安装时会注册桌面条目。使用 AppImage 时，请将随包的 `pantry.desktop` 集成到应用菜单，以显示应用名称和图标。
- 升级沿用原来的数据目录，已有聊天记录和本机身份可继续使用。

- **Fixed garbled names in Ubuntu Dock and notification banners (#92)**. GNOME now identifies Teahouse windows on both XWayland and native Wayland and displays the app name and teacup icon.
- The deb registers the desktop entry during installation. For AppImage, integrate the bundled `pantry.desktop` entry into the application menu to display the app name and icon.
- Upgrades keep the existing profile directory, chat history, and device identity.

### 验证 / Validation

在 Ubuntu 26.04.1 的 GNOME 50.1 虚拟桌面上，从 v0.64.3 升级后，对 XWayland 和原生 Wayland 分别验证了 Dock 图标、聊天通知来源和旧消息读取。

The deb upgrade from v0.64.3 was tested on a virtual Ubuntu 26.04.1 desktop with GNOME 50.1. Both XWayland and native Wayland showed the expected Dock icon and notification source, and the upgraded client retained its chat history.
